subject: Audit The16thFrame periodic path for live-read animation
description: Watch item from #19 (merged da65a5097): tick_periodic_ai_for_npc_with_animation and tick_npc_post_detection_tail_for_npc still thread a live-read animation instead of the latched installed_order mirror (C++ GetAnimation() reads mpOrder).
